exposure: GDM diagnosis during the blockade period
outcome: proportion of pregnant women undergoing oral glucose tolerance tests (OGTT)
cohort: The participants were pregnant women who underwent oral glucose tolerance tests and those diagnosed with GDM in Hangzhou, China, from 2019 to 2021.
finding: The prevalence of GDM increased during the most severe period of the COVID-19 epidemic but decreased year by year overall from 2019 to 2021, and the pandemic did not alter the risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes in pregnant women with GDM.
